result.summary: The student home (/Users/thomasseirer/Weft/Weft/StudentClassHomeView.swift) implements two-level navigation WITHOUT NavigationStack: one ScrollView whose content is conditionally swapped on `app.selectedClassId == nil`. Level 1 renders an intro headline, a Kicker("Your classes"), and one glass card-button per class (icon + name + sub-line badge + chevron.right) that calls `app.selectClass(c.id)`. Level 2 renders a detailHeader (plain accent back button "‹ Your classes" calling `app.leaveClass()` + serif 24 class name) followed by GlassCard(padding:0) section lists with divider-separated rows. The swap animates via `.animation(.easeOut(duration: 0.2), value: app.selectedClassId)` on the shared content VStack (plus identical modifiers keyed to classWork.count and enrolledClasses.count). The column is `.padding(Theme.Space.xl).frame(maxWidth: 560).frame(maxWidth: .infinity)` inside `VStack(spacing:0){ WeftTopBar(role:); ScrollView{...} }.background(AmbientBackground()).task{ await app.loadStudentHome() }`. AppState owns the swap: `selectedClassId: String?`; `selectClass` clears classWork before reloading so stale rows never flash under the new header; `leaveClass` nils the id and refreshes the list badges; `loadStudentHome` is reentrancy-guarded, drops a vanished selection, and auto-enters only when exactly one class exists. Badges are silent until data loads (openBadge returns nil when classOpenCounts[id] is missing). Error banner is a warn-tinted rounded HStack (triangle icon + message + plain accent Retry) rendered above either level; TeacherHomeView:223 already copies it. Reusable kit: Kicker, Chip(kind: .good for live/open), GlassCard, WeftTopBar, .weftGlass(), .rowHover(), .linkPointer(), AmbientBackground, Theme.serif/sans/Space/Radius. The spec (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-06-10-class-first-teacher-design.md) maps this to a new `teacherSelectedClassId`, retires TeacherTab (AppState.swift:96-97, TeacherHomeView.swift:32-43), and — per the user's overriding direction — "Review essays" must live on session-history rows (grade days later), with the live card kept monitoring-only, not the spec's "Live now card: ... Review essays" wording.

Both openGrading and loadGrading must key on the new gradingSession, and ReviewGradingView's .task re-load must survive view re-instantiation days later.

endSession sweep clears gradingSubmissions/grades/roster (AppState 618-620) and sets teacherTab=.build (621); with TeacherTab retired and grading session-keyed, decide what the sweep clears — the just-closed session must remain gradable from history (the defect's acceptance test).

TeacherTab is written at AppState 96-97, 390, 574, 584, 621 and read throughout TeacherHomeView (16-18, 32-48); removing it without sweeping all writers breaks the build or leaves dead live-restoration logic. loadTeacherHome must instead prime teacherSelectedClassId to the live session's class (spec §4).

ExamSession.createdAt: listOpenSessions' explicit select (SupabaseManager 438) and the lookup_session_by_code RPC won't return created_at — it must stay optional; ExamSession has synthesized (non-tolerant) Codable unlike the house pattern (ClassRoom/Assignment write tolerant init(from:)), so a malformed/absent-strategy date would throw the whole row. Spec explicitly asks for a tolerant decode.

Do NOT touch Weft.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj: its only dirty change is the local deployment-target downgrade 26.3->26.1 — committing it, reverting it, or letting Xcode rewrite it clobbers the user's machine-compat fix. New view files need no registration (fileSystemSynchronized groups).

Shared single errorMessage: the class-detail listClassSessions banner and the home banner both render app.errorMessage; a failed background load can bleed errors across levels. Existing screens null errorMessage on every navigation action — keep that discipline (or follow the submittedEssayError precedent of a dedicated field).

launchSession guard copy (AppState 559) references the retired 'Live tab'; spec §4 requires naming the class owning the live session — needs ExamSession.classId -> teacherClasses name resolution with a fallback.

Stale-rows discipline: classSessions must be cleared when switching classes (mirror selectClass clearing classWork at AppState 332-336) or class A's history flashes under class B's header — a bug class this repo has already fixed twice (commits b39de27, 2184501).

Title resolution for history rows depends on `assignments` already being loaded (listTeacherTests is teacher-scoped); sessions whose test was deleted or belongs to another teacher show the 'Assignment' fallback — acceptable per spec, but a class-detail opened before loadTeacherHome completes would transiently show all-fallback titles.

First-release email gate: gradesFresh is reset at the top of loadGrading (634); any new code path that opens grading without awaiting a successful load keeps wasFresh false and silently suppresses the (correct) first-release email — preserve the openGrading -> loadGrading ordering.

Preview/mock parity is a stated invariant: every new surface (class cards with LIVE badge, session history with one open + one closed row, in-place Live card) needs a signed-out mock branch, or the dev gallery and spec's 'demoable' acceptance test fail.

result.summary: The teacher UI is a four-screen flow routed by AppState.teacherScreen (WeftApp.swift:97-101: home/editor/grading/roster). TeacherHomeView is mode-based: a segmented Build/Live Picker bound to app.teacherTab swaps buildView (Session launcher card with idPickers writing pickedAssignmentId/pickedClassId + Start live assignment; Assignments library card; Classes card with per-class Roster buttons) and liveView (live-status card reading liveSession?.code with End session, plus a monitoring roster card that ALSO carries the "Review essays" -> app.openGrading() button — the exact affordance the user wants off the live surface). Grading is session-implicit: openGrading() (AppState.swift:625) derives the title from liveSession?.testId and loadGrading() (AppState.swift:632) guards on liveSession?.id, so closed-session essays are unreachable (the defect). ReviewGradingView is a 3-column grader whose live-vs-sample switch is simply `isLive = app.signedIn` (line 155): signed-in maps app.gradingSubmissions + app.grades + app.roster (for names) into ReviewEntry rows; signed-out renders 5 hardcoded ReviewEntry.mock students. Its .task calls app.loadGrading() and its close button calls app.teacherGoHome(). TeacherRosterView is class-scoped (classRoster/rosterClassId/rosterClassName, loadRoster, inviteStudents) and per spec stays unchanged. DevGalleryView's DevScreen enum has four teacher entries — .teacher ("Teacher · Build / Live", aliases build/live, builds TeacherHomeView()), .templates, .editor, and .grading (builds ReviewGradingView() with no args) — all must keep compiling, so TeacherHomeView() and ReviewGradingView() need to keep parameterless inits, which means teacherSelectedClassId and the new gradingSession belong on AppState, exactly as the spec prescribes. UI vocabulary: GlassCard (Components.swift:77, padding:0 variant for list cards), Chip (.good/.warn/.bad/.accent/.neutral), Kicker, per-view private sectionHeader + errorBanner helpers (house style duplicated in StudentClassHomeView/AssignmentEditorView), Theme.sans/serif + Theme.Space (xs..xxxl) + Theme.Radius, native .buttonStyle(.glass)/.glassProminent, weftGlass()/AmbientBackground (Glass.swift), WeftTopBar, rowHover()/linkPointer(). The pbxproj uses PBXFileSystemSynchronizedRootGroup, so new .swift files in Weft/ compile without pbxproj edits.
keyFacts: USER-DIRECTION vs SPEC conflict: spec line 38 puts 'Review essays' ON the Live-now card; the user's direction explicitly forbids grading affordances on the live surface (monitoring only). Honor the user: grading entry lives only on session-history rows (an ended session row, or the open session's history row), not on the live monitor card.

The defect mechanism: AppState.openGrading() (line 625-630) resolves gradingTitle from liveSession?.testId, and loadGrading() (line 632-653) guards `guard let sid = liveSession?.id else { return }` — once endSession() sets liveSession = nil (line 617) and clears gradingSubmissions/grades/roster (618-620), submissions are unreachable. Fix = spec section 2: openGrading(session:title:) sets a new AppState.gradingSession; loadGrading reads gradingSession.id; saveGrade's reload at line 680 then naturally re-targets the explicit session.

TeacherTab is fully self-contained and cheap to retire: enum+var at AppState.swift:96-97, four writes (390 restore-open-session, 574 preview launch, 584 real launch, 621 endSession reset), six view references all inside TeacherHomeView.swift (16-17 binding, 33-34 picker tags, 43 branch, 48 animation). Nothing else in the codebase touches it.

AppState.roster ([RosterStudent]) is the SESSION roster shared by two consumers: TeacherHomeView's live monitor (lines 175/197/203) and ReviewGradingView's name resolution (line 234 via liveName). loadGrading overwrites it (line 646). Under grading-by-session, grading a closed session while another session is live would clobber the live monitor's roster — grading needs its own roster store (e.g. gradingRoster) or the live card must reload after grading closes.

ReviewGradingView's live/sample switch is `private var isLive: Bool { app.signedIn }` (line 155) — NOT based on data presence. Signed-in with zero submissions shows the '__none__' placeholder ('No submissions'); signed-out always shows ReviewEntry.mock (5 students, 3 essays). assignmentTitle (line 157-159) falls back to 'Lit essay 1 · AP English'; the prompt (line 160) is a hardcoded sample even on live data — a known gap, untouched by the spec.

DevScreen entries referencing teacher screens: .teacher (title 'Teacher · Build / Live' line 41, aliases ['teacher','build','live'] line 61, builds TeacherHomeView() line 79), .templates (line 80, TemplatePickerView), .editor (line 81, AssignmentEditorView), .grading (title line 44, aliases ['grading','grade','review'] line 64, builds ReviewGradingView() line 82). TeacherRosterView is NOT in DevScreen. WeftApp.swift uses DevScreen at lines 22/26/33 (WEFT_SCREEN hook). Titles/aliases are plain strings (compile-safe even if stale); the no-arg view inits at lines 79/82 are the hard compile constraint.

TeacherFlowView (WeftApp.swift:100) also constructs ReviewGradingView() with no arguments, and the Preview blocks construct TeacherHomeView()/ReviewGradingView()/TeacherRosterView() bare — so gradingSession and teacherSelectedClassId must be AppState state, never view-init parameters.

launchSession's one-live-session guard string at AppState.swift:559 says 'End the current live session first (Live tab), then launch the new draft.' — '(Live tab)' must be reworded; spec wants it to name the owning class.

ExamSession (Models.swift:134-146) has id/code/testId/classId/status only — no created_at; the spec's listClassSessions needs it added as an optional with tolerant decode. Existing producers: SupabaseManager.listOpenSessions (line 436), launchSession (line 567), lookupSession.

TeacherRosterView is class-based (classRoster/rosterClassId/rosterClassName/loadRoster/inviteStudents — all distinct from the session roster) and the spec keeps it unchanged; its back button calls app.teacherGoHome().

Class-first precedent already exists on the student side: AppState.selectedClassId + selectClass/leaveClass (lines 326-336) and StudentClassHomeView — the spec's teacherSelectedClassId mirrors this pattern.

Weft.xcodeproj uses PBXFileSystemSynchronizedRootGroup (3 occurrences; no per-file references) — new .swift files dropped in Weft/ are picked up automatically, so the no-pbxproj-edits constraint does not block adding files.

result.summary: Weft's data layer is a hand-rolled URLSession PostgREST client (SupabaseManager, singleton, no SDK). Reads use the generic `rows(_ table:query:)` helper with URLQueryItem-based `select=`/filters/`order=`; writes use `insert`/`update`/`upsert` with private inline `Payload: Encodable` structs and client-stamped `Self.nowISO()` timestamps; RPCs go through `rpc(name, params:)`. A new `listClassSessions(classId:)` should sit in the "Teacher reads" section (SupabaseManager.swift:418-475) and mirror listOpenSessions exactly: `rows("sessions", query: [select: "id,code,test_id,class_id,status,created_at", class_id: "eq.\(classId)", order: "created_at.desc"])`. ExamSession (Models.swift:134-146) is plain synthesized Codable with CodingKeys (no custom init); adding `var createdAt: Date? = nil` + `case createdAt = "created_at"` decodes tolerantly via synthesized decodeIfPresent (absent key -> nil), with the `= nil` default preserving the memberwise-init call at AppState.swift:571; a house-style custom `init(from:)` with `try?` on createdAt is the extra-safe option since launchSession's return=representation insert and lookup_session_by_code RPC also decode this type. AppState teacher lifecycle: enterTeacher (147) sets teacherScreen=.home and fires loadTeacherHome (373), which loads teacherClasses+assignments, re-seeds pickedAssignmentId/pickedClassId, and restores an open session from listOpenSessions(.first), setting teacherTab=.live. launchSession (556) guards liveSession==nil (one-live-session invariant), has a `!signedIn` mock branch, then inserts the session, loads the roster, flips teacherTab=.live, fires best-effort notify. endSession (601) sweeps ALL open sessions via endAllOpenSessions, then clears liveSession/gradingSubmissions/grades/roster and resets teacherTab=.build (on network failure it keeps the live card). openGrading (625) and loadGrading (632) are the defect: both key on liveSession (title from liveSession?.testId, load from liveSession?.id), so closed sessions are unreachable — they must take an explicit session per spec. signOut (163-195) resets all teacher state to mock samples; dropMockData (200) clears only student-side mocks (teacher arrays get overwritten by loadTeacherHome). Mock-when-signed-out: properties initialize with .sample data, every teacher mutation has an `if !signedIn { local mutation; return }` branch, and ReviewGradingView gates real-vs-mock on `isLive = app.signedIn`.
keyFacts: launchSession (SupabaseManager.swift:566-577) inserts into "sessions" with Payload {code, teacher_ip, status:"open", teacher_user_id, test_id, class_id} and returns `result.first` of [ExamSession] decoded from return=representation — so the INSERT response includes created_at and the new field must decode tolerantly there too. listGrades (468-475) shows the in.(...) filter: `URLQueryItem(name: "submission_id", value: "in.(" + ids.joined(separator: ",") + ")")`.

ExamSession decode today (Models.swift:134-146): synthesized Codable, NO custom init(from:). Fields: id, code, testId? ("test_id"), classId? ("class_id"), status. Adding `var createdAt: Date? = nil` plus `case createdAt = "created_at"` is sufficient: synthesized decoding of an optional uses decodeIfPresent (missing key -> nil), and the `= nil` default keeps the memberwise init call at AppState.swift:571 (mock launch path: ExamSession(id:"local-session", code:, testId:, classId:, status:"open")) compiling. Dates decode via decoder.dateDecodingStrategy = .supabase (SupabaseManager.swift:1019-1031, fractional-then-plain ISO8601) — already used for created_at columns elsewhere (ClassEnrollment, ClassRoom.archivedAt). The maximally tolerant house pattern (ClassRoom/Question/Assignment/RosterStudent) is a custom init(from:) using `try?` for the new field, which also shields lookup_session_by_code RPC rows that may carry created_at in an odd shape.

ExamSession decode call sites (all must stay unaffected): listOpenSessions (SupabaseManager.swift:436), lookupSession RPC lookup_session_by_code (279-283, used by student paths AppState 731/752/1007), launchSession insert (573), endAllOpenSessions phantom decode (585).

AppState teacher lifecycle — enterTeacher (AppState.swift:147-153): role=.teacher, displayName fallback, teacherScreen=.home, route=.teacher, then `if signedIn { resolvePendingDeepLink(); Task { await loadTeacherHome() } }`.

loadTeacherHome (AppState.swift:373-395): guard signedIn (mocks persist otherwise); teacherClasses = listTeacherClasses(); assignments = listTeacherTests(userId:); re-seeds pickedAssignmentId from groupedAssignments.first (379-381) and pickedClassId from teacherClasses.first (382-384); restores an open session: `if liveSession == nil, let open = try? await supabase.listOpenSessions(userId: userId).first { liveSession = open; await loadLiveRoster(); teacherTab = .live }` (387-391). Spec adds: prime teacherSelectedClassId from liveSession.classId here. Single do/catch — a failure before the restore skips it.

launchSession (AppState.swift:556-593): guard liveSession == nil else errorMessage = "End the current live session first (Live tab), then launch the new draft." (558-561 — spec: re-word to name the owning class); guards pickedAssignmentId (562) and pickedClassId (566); `!signedIn` mock branch (570-576) fabricates ExamSession(id:"local-session") + roster = RosterStudent.sample + teacherTab=.live; signed-in: fetch public IP, supabase.launchSession, loadLiveRoster(), teacherTab=.live (584), best-effort notify("assignment_launched") (587-589).

endSession (AppState.swift:601-622): when signedIn calls endAllOpenSessions (closes EVERY open row — the one-live-session sweep; stale rows from crashes would otherwise be resurrected by loadTeacherHome); on failure sets errorMessage and RETURNS keeping the live card. On success/preview: liveSession=nil, gradingSubmissions=[], grades=[:], roster=[], teacherTab=.build (617-621). teacherTab=.build must be replaced when TeacherTab is retired.

THE DEFECT — openGrading (AppState.swift:625-630): gradingTitle = assignments.first(where: { $0.id == liveSession?.testId })?.title ?? "Submissions"; teacherScreen=.grading; Task loadGrading(). loadGrading (632-653): `guard let sid = liveSession?.id else { return }` — silently no-ops once a session closes; then gradesFresh=false, preview branch clears gradingSubmissions/grades, signed-in loads listSessionSubmissions(sid), refreshes shared `roster` via listSessionStudents(sid), builds grades dict from listGrades, sets gradesFresh=true. Spec: both take an explicit ExamSession; new `gradingSession` state replaces the liveSession reads.

saveGrade (AppState.swift:658-690) keys on submission ids only (sessionId/studentId come off the TeacherSubmission) — unchanged by the redesign; first-release email gate uses private gradesFresh (set only by a successful loadGrading) + existing==nil (684-686).

signOut resets (AppState.swift:163-195): useMockData=true; teacher block at 184-193: teacherScreen=.home, editingAssignment=nil, liveSession=nil, pickedAssignmentId/pickedClassId=nil, classRoster=[]/rosterClassId=nil/rosterClassName="", gradingSubmissions=[]/grades=[:], teacherClasses=[.sample,.sample2], assignments=[.sample,.sample2], roster=RosterStudent.sample. New state (teacherSelectedClassId, classSessions, gradingSession) MUST be reset here.

dropMockData (AppState.swift:200-207) runs at sign-in success (225) and clears ONLY student-side mocks (enrolledClasses, classWork, classOpenCounts, returnedWork, selectedClassId, activeAssignment); teacher mock arrays are instead overwritten by the subsequent loadTeacherHome. A mock `classSessions` is loaded lazily per class detail, so it needs explicit clearing at sign-in (add to dropMockData) or seeding only behind `!signedIn`.

Mock-when-signed-out pattern: useMockData=true default (AppState.swift:36); data properties initialize with .sample values (67-71, 88-89); every teacher action has an early `if !signedIn { local mutation; return }` branch — createClass (415-420), loadRoster (433-440), saveAssignment (458-479), createNextDraft (528-540), launchSession (570-576), loadGrading (635-641), inviteStudents (926-929). ReviewGradingView gates on `isLive = app.signedIn` (ReviewGradingView.swift:155) with mock fallbacks (title fallback "Lit essay 1 · AP English" at 158). DevGalleryView renders TeacherHomeView/ReviewGradingView unsigned (DevGalleryView.swift:79,82), so the new two-level home must stay demoable from mocks per spec section 5.

One-live-session invariant enforcement points: launchSession guard (AppState.swift:558-561), endAllOpenSessions sweep (SupabaseManager.swift:583-590, doc comment 579-582), loadTeacherHome restore taking `.first` of open sessions (AppState.swift:387). Note listOpenSessions has no order clause — `.first` is arbitrary if stale rows exist, acceptable only because the sweep closes them all.

TeacherScreen (AppState.swift:92-93) keeps editor/grading/roster; routed in WeftApp.swift TeacherFlowView 97-104.
